mapper.select: select id from lab_member where user_id=#{userId} and member_status='ACTIVE' and del_flag='0' limit 1
select biz_line from lab_member where id=#{memberId} and member_status='ACTIVE' and del_flag='0' limit 1
select from lab_task t where t.id=#{id} and t.del_flag='0'
select from lab_task t where t.id=#{id} and t.del_flag='0' for update
select from lab_task t where t.carried_from_id=#{carriedFromId} and t.period=#{period} and t.del_flag='0' limit 1
select from lab_task t where t.parent_id=#{parentId} and t.del_flag='0' order by t.period,t.plan_date,t.id

select , coalesce((select e.to_status from lab_task_execution_event e where e.task_id=t.id and e.event_time<=#{asOf} and e.del_flag='0' order by e.event_time desc,e.id desc limit 1), case when t.create_time<=#{asOf} then t.execution_status else null end) execution_status_as_of, (select min(e.event_time) from lab_task_execution_event e where e.task_id=t.id and e.to_status='ACTIVE' and e.event_time<=#{asOf} and e.del_flag='0') execution_activated_at, exists(select 1 from lab_task_block_event b where b.task_id=t.id and b.block_start_time<=#{asOf} and (b.block_end_time is null or b.block_end_time>#{asOf}) and b.del_flag='0') blocked_at_as_of, (select min(b.block_start_time) from lab_task_block_event b where b.task_id=t.id and b.block_start_time<=#{asOf} and (b.block_end_time is null or b.block_end_time>#{asOf}) and b.del_flag='0') block_start_at_as_of from lab_task t where t.parent_id=#{parentId} and t.task_level='week' and t.del_flag='0' order by t.id
select from lab_task t where t.parent_id=#{parentId} and t.del_flag='0' order by t.id for update
select from lab_task t where t.milestone_id=#{milestoneId} and t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' and t.del_flag='0' order by t.period,t.id
select from lab_task t where t.milestone_id=#{milestoneId} and t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' and t.del_flag='0' order by t.id for update
select from lab_task t where t.milestone_id=#{milestoneId} and t.del_flag='0' order by t.id for update
select from lab_task t where (t.goal_id=#{goalId} or t.milestone_id=#{goalId}) and t.del_flag='0' order by t.id for update
select count(1) from lab_task where milestone_id=#{milestoneId} and del_flag='0'
select from lab_task t where t.owner_id=#{ownerId} and t.period=#{period} and t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' and t.del_flag='0' order by t.id
select from lab_task t where t.owner_id=#{ownerId} and t.period=#{period} and t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' and t.del_flag='0' order by t.id for update
select biz_line from lab_member where id=#{memberId} and member_status='ACTIVE' and del_flag='0' for update
mapper.update: update lab_task set parent_id=#{parentId},goal_id=#{goalId},milestone_id=#{milestoneId},task_level=#{taskLevel},period=#{period},biz_line=#{bizLine},task_type=#{taskType},title=#{title},owner_id=#{ownerId},dept_id=#{deptId},plan_date=#{planDate},actual_finish_time=#{actualFinishTime},deliverable=#{deliverable},perf_weight=#{perfWeight},goal_weight=#{goalWeight},workflow_status=#{workflowStatus},result_status=#{resultStatus},execution_status=#{executionStatus},carried_from_id=#{carriedFromId},execution_version=#{executionVersion},result_desc=#{resultDesc},fail_reason=#{failReason},next_action=#{nextAction},asset_id=#{assetId},coordination_required=#{coordinationRequired},coordination_owner_id=#{coordinationOwnerId},coordination_dept_id=#{coordinationDeptId},coordination_content=#{coordinationContent},coordination_support=#{coordinationSupport},coordination_desc=#{coordinationDesc},current_block_flag=#{blockFlag},current_block_start=#{blockStartTime},period_lock_flag=#{periodLockFlag},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),remark=#{remark},version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and del_flag='0'
update lab_task set del_flag='2',update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select id,task_id,gate_no,gate_name,gate_status,evidence_id,checker_id,check_time,check_result,del_flag,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time,remark from lab_task_quality_gate where task_id=#{taskId} and del_flag='0' order by gate_no,id

select id,task_id,gate_no,gate_name,gate_status,evidence_id,checker_id,check_time,check_result,del_flag,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time,remark from lab_task_quality_gate where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
mapper.insert: insert into lab_task_quality_gate(task_id,gate_no,gate_name,gate_status,evidence_id,checker_id,check_time,check_result,del_flag,create_by,create_time,remark) select #{taskId},#{gateNo},#{gateName},#{gateStatus},#{evidenceId},#{checkerId},#{checkTime},#{checkResult},#{delFlag},#{createBy},sysdate(),#{remark} from lab_task t where t.id=#{taskId} and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and t.period_lock_flag='0' and t.del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update lab_task_quality_gate g join lab_task t on t.id=g.task_id set g.gate_no=#{gateNo},g.gate_name=#{gateName},g.update_by=#{updateBy},g.update_time=sysdate(),g.remark=#{remark} where g.id=#{id} and g.task_id=#{taskId} and g.gate_status='PENDING' and g.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and t.period_lock_flag='0' and t.del_flag='0'

update lab_task_quality_gate g join lab_task t on t.id=g.task_id set g.del_flag='2',g.update_by=#{updateBy},g.update_time=sysdate() where g.id=#{id} and g.gate_status='PENDING' and g.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and t.period_lock_flag='0' and t.del_flag='0'

update lab_task_quality_gate g join lab_task t on t.id=g.task_id join lab_task_evidence e on e.id=#{evidenceId} and e.task_id=g.task_id set g.gate_status='PASSED',g.evidence_id=#{evidenceId},g.checker_id=#{checkerId},g.check_time=#{checkTime},g.check_result=#{checkResult},g.update_by=#{updateBy},g.update_time=sysdate() where g.id=#{id} and g.gate_status='PENDING' and g.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status='CONFIRMED' and t.period_lock_flag='0' and t.del_flag='0' and e.audit_status='APPROVED' and e.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select id,task_id,episode_no,carried_from_event_id,block_type,block_reason,block_start_time,block_end_time,block_status,resolver_id,resolution,del_flag,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time,remark from lab_task_block_event where task_id=#{taskId} and block_status='OPEN' and del_flag='0' order by id desc limit 1

select id,task_id,episode_no,carried_from_event_id,block_type,block_reason,block_start_time,block_end_time,block_status,resolver_id,resolution,del_flag,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time,remark from lab_task_block_event where task_id=#{taskId} and del_flag='0' order by episode_no desc,id desc
